summary.title: CO4_AT2_Ecommerce_Behavior
summary.description: "An e-commerce platform that captures customer clickstream, cart, and payment behavior in real time to detect cart abandonment, identify payment failures, and support marketing decisions through a big data pipeline."

diagrams.title: Ecommerce_DataFlow.
diagrams.description: A data flow diagram showing how customer clickstream, cart, and payment data moves through the e-commerce pipeline — from customer and payment gateway (external entities), through the ingestion API and stream processor, into the data lake, and out to the dashboard — including a trust boundary between the public internet and internal system.
